LanguageData.MOF_CopySettingsDesc: Copy this building's settings to the clipboard so you can paste them onto another building. Processes, allowed fuels and the fuel level are copied, whichever of them this building has.
LanguageData.MOF_PasteSettingsDesc: Overwrite the settings of every selected building with those previously copied to the clipboard. Anything a building does not have is left alone.
LanguageData.MOF_TreeLayer: Where the great trees are drawn
LanguageData.MOF_TreeLayerLowDesc: The great trees still cover ordinary trees, but your colonists and anything lying on the ground stay visible in front of them.
LanguageData.MOF_TreeLayerAbovePawnsDesc: The canopy covers everything on the ground, colonists included. Move the cursor near a tree to see through it.
LanguageData.MOF_TreeLayerTopDesc: Drawn above weather and overlays as well. This is what Medieval Overhaul does for the great oak on its own.
LanguageData.MOF_IndoorDrying: Drying racks and the charcoal pile work under a roof
LanguageData.MOF_IndoorDryingDesc: Medieval Overhaul keeps these three outdoors twice over: it refuses the placement under a roof, and it also stops the process from running there. This lifts both, so they can be built indoors and actually work. Off by default.
LanguageData.MOF_TanningLiquorCounts: Tiny, small, medium and large hide: {0}.
LanguageData.MOF_TanningLiquorBatch: One batch of {0} covers {1} large hides.
